# `duplicate-definition`: Design unit is defined more than once / 设计单元被重复定义

**Severity / 严重程度:** `error`

## English

### Cause

Two modules, interfaces, packages, or other design units introduce the same name into the same compilation scope.

### Risk

Elaboration becomes ambiguous or fails, and tool-dependent file ordering can select an unintended definition.

### Fix

Keep one authoritative definition or rename genuinely distinct units and update every reference consistently.

## 简体中文

### 原因

两个 module、interface、package 或其他设计单元在同一编译作用域中引入了相同名称。

### 风险

设计展开会产生歧义或失败，依赖文件顺序的工具还可能选择错误定义。

### 修复

只保留一个权威定义；若确实是不同单元则重命名，并一致更新所有引用。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module duplicated_unit(input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  assign data_o = data_i;
endmodule

module duplicated_unit(input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  assign data_o = ~data_i;
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module duplicate_definition_a(input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  assign data_o = data_i;
endmodule

module duplicate_definition_b(input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  assign data_o = ~data_i;
endmodule
```
